name: Ewing Sarcoma
definition: Aggressive small-round-cell malignancy of bone or soft tissue, common in children and adolescents.

investigations.principle: Radiographs, MRI and systemic staging are required; biopsy should be sarcoma-team planned.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, tumor or occult-injury assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific pathway.

amber: Do not assume infection if the course or imaging is atypical.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Asthi/Majja framework may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Aggressive small-round-cell malignancy of bone or soft tissue, common in children and adolescents.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for rapidly progressive weakness, respiratory/swallowing compromise, major vascular symptoms, suspected malignancy/pathological fracture, severe systemic illness or other listed red flags.
